rappel_detail.station: Just below the summit, working down and south toward the South Ridge route.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, optional, to get below the initial band of rock; many parties downclimb it. Then continue south to the south col and down the South Ridge’s loose, cairned gully.

set.rappels: One optional short rappel (or a downclimb) below the summit on the South Ridge descent; the ridge itself is downclimbed
